findings.title: SOQL Injection
findings.explanation: The subjectFilter input is concatenated into a dynamic SOQL string without using bind variables, risking SOQL injection.
findings.remediation: Use bind variables or Database.queryWithBinds to safely include user input in SOQL queries.

findings.title: CRUD/FLS Violation
findings.explanation: The query does not enforce field-level security (FLS) by using WITH SECURITY_ENFORCED.
findings.remediation: Change the query to use WITH SECURITY_ENFORCED to enforce field-level security.

findings.title: SOQL Injection
findings.explanation: The searchKey parameter is concatenated directly into a dynamic SOQL query string, which can lead to SOQL injection.
findings.remediation: Use bind variables or String.escapeSingleQuotes to safely include user input in SOQL queries.

findings.title: CRUD/FLS Violation
findings.explanation: The query does not enforce CRUD and FLS permissions, which can allow users to access fields they do not have permission to view.
findings.remediation: Use WITH SECURITY_ENFORCED in the SOQL query to enforce CRUD and FLS permissions.

findings.title: SOSL Injection
findings.explanation: User input is concatenated into a SOSL search term, allowing an attacker to inject malicious input.
findings.remediation: Use bind variables or String.escapeSingleQuotes to safely handle user input in dynamic queries.

findings.title: FLS Violation

findings.title: CRUD/FLS Violation
findings.explanation: The delete operation does not enforce CRUD/FLS permissions, potentially allowing users to delete records they do not have permission to delete.
findings.remediation: Use 'delete [SELECT Id FROM Asset WHERE Id = :assetId WITH USER_MODE]' to enforce CRUD/FLS permissions.

findings.title: CRUD/FLS Violation
findings.explanation: The Apex class does not enforce CRUD and FLS permissions for the Contact object and its fields.
findings.remediation: Use WITH USER_MODE in SOQL queries and enforce FLS for field access.

findings.title: FLS Violation
findings.explanation: The Apex class does not validate field-level security for the Contact fields accessed and updated.
findings.remediation: Use Security.stripInaccessible to enforce FLS for field access.

findings.title: CRUD/FLS Violation
findings.explanation: The query and update operations do not enforce CRUD and FLS permissions, allowing users to access and modify fields they may not have permission to.
findings.remediation: Use WITH USER_MODE in the SOQL query and enforce FLS using Security.stripInaccessible or similar methods.

findings.title: Sharing Violation
findings.explanation: The query runs in system mode, ignoring record-level sharing rules.
findings.remediation: Use WITH USER_MODE in the SOQL query to enforce record-level sharing rules.

findings.title: CRUD/FLS Violation
findings.explanation: The code does not check if the user has create permission on the Task object before inserting a new task.
findings.remediation: Add a CRUD check using Security.stripInaccessible or enforce user mode for the insert operation.

findings.title: FLS Violation
findings.explanation: The code does not validate field-level security for the Task fields being inserted.
findings.remediation: Use Security.stripInaccessible to enforce FLS before inserting the Task record.

findings.title: Excessive Permissions
findings.explanation: The permission set grants edit access to the Case object, which may be more than necessary for the purpose of escalating cases.
findings.remediation: Review and adjust the object permissions to follow the principle of least privilege.

findings.title: Sharing violation
findings.explanation: The class is declared 'without sharing', which means it ignores record-level sharing rules. This allows partner community users to see opportunities from all accounts, not just their own.

findings.title: Guest user exposure
findings.explanation: The permission set grants access to the FinancialDashboardController class, which is declared 'without sharing'. This means that if the permission set is assigned to a guest user, they could potentially access sensitive data.
findings.remediation: Ensure that the FinancialDashboardController class is declared 'with sharing' and that the permission set is not assigned to guest users.

findings.title: Sharing violation
findings.explanation: DataAggregator is declared 'without sharing', which means it ignores record-level sharing rules. This class is reachable from an @AuraEnabled method, making it accessible to external users who can bypass sharing rules.
findings.remediation: Change the sharing mode of DataAggregator to 'with sharing' to enforce record-level sharing rules.
